budgets.title: one pass to build, then a constant cost per update
budgets.why: Ten totals queries currently mean ten full rebuilds. Read the rows once, keep the running totals, and each update costs at most two folds: take the old amount out of its team, put the new one in.

budgets.title: asking a different question does not cost a rebuild
budgets.why: The top team is a fact about totals you already maintain. Rebuilding the totals to rank them is recomputing the answer you were holding.

budgets.title: forty updates and twenty queries still cost one pass
budgets.why: Interleaving the two query kinds changes nothing: the view is maintained by the updates, and a query reads what is already there.
